description: learner-attrition-radar: a Prediction API scoring dropout risk for self-paced online learners from behavioral telemetry (session cadence, quiz scores, video completion, forum activity), with PSI-based drift tracking as engagement patterns shift over a course's lifetime.
notes: Earlier run today hit a non-transient 403 on mcp__github__create_repository (GitHub App installation lacks repo-creation scope) and stopped after Phase A/B with repo=null. The owner manually created the empty repository (github.com/Mallika56/learner-attrition-radar) via a differently-permissioned token to unblock this. This session attached it with push access and completed Phase C: scaffolded the full mandatory stack (FastAPI with 5 endpoints -- /predict /health /metrics /drift /retrain; RandomForest ensemble on disclosed synthetic data; 6-feature pipeline; SQLAlchemy prediction-log + experiment-run models with SQLite dev / Postgres-via-compose config; Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml; 14 pytest tests with the model and DB stubbed/in-memory; documented .env.example; ruff+pytest CI workflow; matplotlib architecture diagram) plus 4 bonus items (PSI drift detection, cross-validated AUC-ROC/precision/recall reporting, experiment tracking, an automated /retrain endpoint). All 23 commits (one file per commit) pushed cleanly to origin/main; full test suite and ruff both pass. Phase C.5 (ship) partially failed: `git tag v1.0.0` was created locally and `git push origin main --follow-tags` succeeded for main, but `git push origin v1.0.0` failed twice with HTTP 403 (the same push credential can push refs/heads/main on this repo but not the tag ref) and ToolSearch found no create-release (or create-tag) tool in this environment's GitHub MCP surface -- only get/list tools for releases and tags exist. So no v1.0.0 tag or release exists on GitHub; that needs a human with full repo credentials to cut manually. SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS are still unset, so the digest email failed as expected (recorded in email_status.json) and never blocked the run. Also flagged to the user: this run executed on a Saturday, but prompts/system_prompt.md's Phase 0 gate defines INNOVATION mode as Wednesday-only and says Saturday/Sunday runs should stop immediately and log nothing -- this session did not re-run Phase 0 since it was an explicit continuation of a same-day stalled run with decided values, but the underlying scheduling mismatch (why INNOVATION fired at all on a Saturday) is unresolved and worth checking.
